subject: general
question: The Hornbill festival is celebrated in which of the following states to promote its cultural heritage?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nagaland__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hornbill Festival is Celebrated in **Nagaland**.
 
• The Festival is celebrated in **Nagaland** to encourage inter-tribal interaction and to protect and revive the uniqueness and richness of the Naga heritage.
 
• This Festival is organized by State Tourism and Art & Culture Departments and also supported by Union Government.
 
• The Hornbill Festival is a celebration held every year from 1 to 10 December.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Famous Festival Of Nagaland:__**

 
 
• ​Hornbill Festival. 
 
• Mim Kut Festival. 
 
• Sekrenyi Festival. 
 
• Aoleng Festival. 
 
• Moatsii Mong. 
 
• Bushu Dima.
